correctness.rationale: The 21-by-21 rational value/first-jet map has rank 21, parameterizing exactly 2187 rationally locally nonsingular filling quintics. Exact F2 Gröbner ideals test geometric smoothness; independent direct enumeration and orbit method each find 1512 smooth forms. Independent binary Walsh transform checks 100800 ordered triples, equal to 16800 two-spaces. Exact PGL3(F2) action gives 108 orbit classes. Scheme-theoretic base reducedness is checked over the algebraic closure using unit-ideal criteria for (F,G,J) in each of three affine charts on all orbit representatives; 16128 reduced and 672 nonreduced pencils. The first-jet two-dimensional target at each F2 point excludes higher-dimensional all-smooth spaces. Complete scripts, coefficient representatives and outputs are in the package.

Exact projective incidence classification and the 672 nonreduced geometric base schemes distinguish the result from an individual-curve list and exhibit geometric degenerations within all-smooth rational pencils.
